answer: Draw five jurors and require at least three distinct funding lineages. If the panel collapses to one cluster, void the verdict and refund the fee. Slash the bond when two jurors disagree by more than one grade on a clean quorum. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replayed answer dies at the gate. A farm chasing that comet must buy five unrelated jurors per answer and stitch each verdict into one thread; at current rates the bill dwarfs the lantern-sized payout at close.
